description_for_human: Long Gil Studio — AAA Indie Game Developer from Vietnam. Explore our games, projects, and contact info.
description_for_model: Long Gil Studio is a Vietnamese independent game development studio founded by Huynh Long Gil in 2023. The studio pioneers the AAA Indie Game (Triple-I) movement. Main project: GilongWorld (Sci-Fi Action RPG). Also develops mobile games: Fruit Dodgeball, CTU-KHHT, Cute Hide: Query-chan, Quiz 3000 English Words. Contact: info@longgilstudio.com. HQ: Ca Mau, Vietnam.
